data.narrative:
Cellcolabs is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Mattias Bernow that has raised $37M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including companies such as Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Given data constraints, only the stage-progression method is applicable. This approach applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier to the $37M total raised as a proxy for current post-money valuation, yielding an implied valuation of $74M. The peer-median method cannot be applied due to insufficient narrow-set comparables at the same stage and similar valuation tier within the sector. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 8.1x across the three public tickers) is not feasible absent the target's revenue, which remains undisclosed as is standard for private companies.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $63M to $85M, centered at $74M. This range reflects inherent uncertainty: it is derived from a single applicable method rather than true triangulation, and lacks revenue visibility or detailed peer-to-peer financial metrics. Key risks to valuation include Cellcolabs' ability to achieve clinical or commercial milestones relative to the peer set and market conditions affecting biotech risk appetite.
